papers.title: SBi3PCF: cosmology with Dark Energy Survey Year 3 cosmic shear
papers.comment: 20 pages (4 figures, 6 tables) + appendices. Comments are welcome!
papers.summary: Simulation-based inference of the integrated 3-point cosmic shear correlation function in DES Y3 tightens wCDM constraints and improves figure of merit by 1.59.

papers.title: A semi-autonomous multi-agent pipeline for high-energy astrophysics research with enforced provenance and verifiable self-extension
papers.summary: A semi-autonomous multi-agent LLM pipeline retrieves and analyses HEASARC data with enforced provenance checks, reproducing published IXPE Cyg X-1 polarization results.

papers.title: The PAU Survey: Self-supervised image denoising for flux-preserving photometry
papers.summary: Flux-aware Noise2Void denoising with bounded outputs and LoRA fine-tuning preserves PAUS galaxy fluxes while halving random photometric scatter.
papers.topic: Source Detection, Deblending and Image Simulation

papers.title: Macrocanonical Generator Networks: Data-Efficient Neural Surrogates for Amortized Physics Simulation
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages total (inc. appendices), 4 figures
papers.summary: Macrocanonical generator networks learn data-efficient neural surrogates matching multiscale statistics, generating cosmology and fluid simulation samples from very small training sets.

papers.title: A Unified AI Framework for Rapid and Accurate Waveform Generation of Compact Binary Coalescences
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material included
papers.summary: A deep-learning framework generates unified compact-binary-coalescence waveforms for black holes, neutron stars and mixed binaries, reaching mismatches of 5.9e-4–5.3e-2 and up to 1800× speedup.
papers.tldr: A unified framework that combines physical modeling with deep learning is developed that generates waveforms for binary black holes, binary neutron stars, and neutron star black hole binaries, providing a single unified generator for all compact binary coalescences.

papers.title: Feature-Based and Deep Learning Methods for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Moscow University Physics Bulletin (DLCP-2026 special issue)
papers.summary: Feature-based models outperform end-to-end deep networks on ZTF variable-star classification across seven imbalanced classes; limited labels explain the gap and motivate self-supervised pretraining.
papers.tldr: It is found that limited labeled data contributes to the performance gap, while the multivariate, irregularly sampled, and morphologically diverse nature of light curves poses additional challenges for deep learning models.

papers.title: Spin Spherical Fourier Neural Operators: Efficient Equivariant Learning for Vector and Spin Fields on the Sphere
papers.summary: Spin spherical Fourier neural operators are extended with exactly rotationally equivariant lifted convolutions, achieving machine-precision equivariance and state-of-the-art results on spherical spin-field benchmarks.
papers.tldr: This work extends spherical Fourier neural operators (SFNOs) to fields of any spin, through lifted spherical convolutions that are exactly rotationally equivariant, and demonstrates empirically that rotational equivariance holds to machine precision for these layers.

papers.title: COSMIO: A Benchmark for Cross-Survey Modality Imputation
papers.summary: COSMIO benchmark forward-renders shared scenes across LSST, Euclid and Roman to test cross-survey imputation; existing methods transfer poorly, especially for rare gravitational lenses.
papers.tldr: COSMIO is introduced, a multi-survey benchmark of aligned observations obtained by forward-rendered shared astrophysical scenes across LSST, Euclid, and Roman under survey-specific instrument characteristics, which enables systematic evaluation of imputation across source-target survey combinations and missing-survey patterns.
